chapter_title_en: The Trial of the Lower Realm
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 371: Ji Ning's Trial Begins – Seeking a Disciple in the Crescent Major World
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning descends to the Star Continent on a master's trial. He must find a disciple and kill a sinner, all while the legendary Evil Dragon River looms as a cursed trap for the desperate.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch 371: The Trial of the Lower Realm
og_description: Ji Ning leaves Mount Innerheart for the chaotic Star Continent. A fleeing royal family seeks refuge in the cursed Evil Dragon River, where a bearer of immense karmic merit awaits.
twitter_title: DE Ch 371: Hunting for a Disciple in Hell
twitter_description: The master sends Ji Ning down to recruit and kill. First stop: a cursed river where even immortals can't fly. First find: a servant girl glowing with golden karma.

lore_anchors.definition: A vast world comparable to the Grand Xia World, housing Mount Innerheart and serving as the geographical base for Patriarch Subhuti's disciples.
A massive, cursed river in the Star Continent said to be formed from the corpse of an ancient evil dragon, within 1,000 li of which even Celestial Immortals cannot fly or use escape techniques.
One of three continents in the Crescent Major World, known for its chaotic and lawless nature with countless demon kings, tribes, and fallen kingdoms.
The ultimate essence of natural energy, used as high-value currency by cultivators and as a resource to instantly boost cultivation without long refinement.
A tangible spiritual light and currency generated by good deeds; it provides protection during tribulations and attracts favorable karmic outcomes in reincarnation.
A heavy spiritual stain generated by mass murder or evil acts; it amplifies the power of the Heavenly Tribulation and can attract Karmic Hellfire.

The life-or-death trial faced by cultivators at the Void stage peak; success grants transcendence from the Three Realms and immortality, while failure means death or a tortured existence as a Loose Immortal.
Periodic ordeals faced by cultivators below Celestial Immortal; minor disasters every three hundred years and major calamities every nine hundred years.
